tests.procedure: Attach diagnostic UI with the base adapter
tests.expected: Clear NotConfigured message; no inventory or successful Start/Continue.

tests.procedure: Generate fresh name with gamepad and start
tests.expected: No keyboard needed; initial pending save becomes an actual verified Saved notice.

tests.procedure: Choose an existing set and press Start New
tests.expected: Original files retained; explicit refusal; no automatic deletion.

tests.procedure: Create A/B pair then open session menu
tests.expected: One deduplicated name; no claim it is validated until Continue.

tests.procedure: Inject unsupported name enumeration
tests.expected: Unavailable differs from empty list; exact-name Continue remains possible.

tests.procedure: Continue a missing/corrupt set
tests.expected: No new game is created; error remains visible.

tests.procedure: Quit and Continue a valid partial mission
tests.expected: Inventory, ledger, world, journal and mission restore together.

tests.procedure: Choose another session while campaign active
tests.expected: Explicit confirmation before replacing live memory; Cancel preserves it.

tests.procedure: Save and Exit on healthy campaign
tests.expected: Exit occurs only after Saved/read-back verification.

tests.procedure: Cause a disposable write failure then Save and Exit
tests.expected: Application remains open; failure is visible; previous slot retained.

tests.procedure: Pause then journal; send repeated Back in one frame
tests.expected: Only journal closes; parent remains focused.

tests.procedure: Hold Escape/B across menu transitions
tests.expected: No rapid multi-layer closure or immediately reopened menu.

tests.procedure: Focus Journal from pause; open/close child
tests.expected: Original pause command regains focus.

tests.procedure: Press move/look/jump/interact under each modal
tests.expected: No world action; bridge blocker and UI-only input both effective.

tests.procedure: Close last modal then move/look
tests.expected: Inputs restored; unrelated existing ignore-input locks preserved.

tests.procedure: End play/re-enter test room repeatedly
tests.expected: No duplicate context, callback, widget or leaked blocker/lock.

tests.procedure: Repair, display transcript, press Back
tests.expected: No messageHeard flag or final journal lead granted.

tests.procedure: Open transcript with held confirm; release then explicitly Continue
tests.expected: No opening-frame acknowledgement; final journal records once.

tests.procedure: Keep old token/widget callback across successful load
tests.expected: Old action rejected; no progress change.

tests.procedure: Do not override ReadContainerView
tests.expected: Explicit unavailable view; no fake empty-ready grid or transfers.

tests.procedure: Return duplicate GUID, overlap, wrong container or mismatched revision
tests.expected: View invalid and transfers disabled.

tests.procedure: Select item; inspect; return using controller
tests.expected: Same selected instance and parent focus retained.

tests.procedure: Move battery to cabin storage and back using gamepad
tests.expected: Real one-item transfers; objective follows carried contents; no duplicate.

tests.procedure: Attempt transfer into full grid
tests.expected: NoSpace visible; source item stays recoverable.

tests.procedure: Change provider state after display before transfer
tests.expected: Refresh/review required; old display does not initiate a new transfer.

tests.procedure: Inject Busy/Failed for a transfer and press Retry
tests.expected: Original request/operation GUID reused; no automatic retries or second intention.

tests.procedure: Move/teleport away while storage panel exists
tests.expected: Invalid context closes; no remote transfer or hidden retry.

tests.procedure: Inject late restore plus failed rollback in disposable session
tests.expected: Non-dismissible recovery; no save; exit/relaunch guidance.

tests.procedure: Run native screens at 1080p and a smaller viewport
tests.expected: Text and all commands reachable; mouse/shoulder scrolling works.

tests.procedure: Complete pickup-storage-repair-transcript-save-relaunch with controller only
tests.expected: Full original M1 invariants pass without mouse or developer commands.

tests.procedure: Cook/package and launch test room outside editor
tests.expected: Native widgets/assets/input are present; no missing critical dependency.
